info.name: Rollbar Deployment Access Tokens Occurrences API
List All Occurrences of an Item

params.name: itemId
params.description: The internal item ID. This is different from the project counter shown in Rollbar URLs.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

items.docs: Returns all occurrences for a specific item, in pages of 20, ordered descending by occurrence ID.

info.name: List All Occurrences in a Project

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

items.docs: Returns all occurrences in the project, in pages of 20, ordered descending by occurrence ID (approximately descending by timestamp).

params.name: instanceId
params.description: The ID of the occurrence instance to retrieve.

items.docs: Returns a single occurrence by its instance ID.
